messages:
sam: FYI we're seeing short, repeating GPU stalls in ap-south1 starting ~03:20 UTC. Not full node OOMs  just stalls + nvlink retries. Looks tied to a tiny cohort on fractional slices hammering KV + outbound.

ivy: can you share prom query + one example tenant?

sam: query: ```sum(rate(kv_out_bytes{region=\"ap-south1\"}[2m])) by (tenant)``` example tenant: tenant-redwood-7

devin: ops-bot shows alert series: ap-south1_slice_burst_stall x4 in 30m. ops-bot:alert_id=aps-burst-742

ops-bot: Alert ap-south1_slice_burst_stall started at 2024-09-11T03:21:05Z severity=warning affected_slices=2

ivy: short-term mitigation idea: introduce a soft "egress gating" policy per fractional slice. allow small bursts, then apply NIC-level token-bucket to throttle bytes/sec and trigger reroute for sustained overload. call it egress_gating v1.

sam: sounds good. prefer same-region hosted fallback first to avoid cross-region fees. For detection avoid false positives by combining kv_out_bytes with nvlink_retry_count and gpu_ctx_switch_rate.

devin: suggested heuristic: ```WHEN kv_out_bytes(tenant) > 150MB/2m AND nvlink_retry_count > 0 AND gpu_ctx_switch_rate_p95 > 0.5 FOR 90s```

ivy: implementation note: avoid heavy tc rules. we have a lightweight eBPF shape-runner prototype:
```
program: egress_gating v1
flags: burst_sec=25, rate_mbps=80, fallback_policy=same-region-hosted, metric_emit=tenant_gate_hits
```

sam: cost check: sample tenant-redwood-7 did ~800k bytes in 4m -> ~30k tokens -> ~+$0.07 if rerouted to hosted at current rates. But if we prevent 2min of stall per neighboring tenant, savings in GPU-minutes likely > $0.07.

devin: ops playbook (draft):
- enable egress_gating canary on 4% of fractional slices in ap-south1 for 24h
- emit tenant_gate_hits, rerouted_tokens_est, slice_gate_active
- notify tenant owner on first reroute, auto-create task if >4 reroutes in 1h
- on suspected false-positive revert gate for that slice for 10m

ivy: also add a flag to tag rerouted requests with billing:egress_fallback=true so billing can surface token movement.

sam: agree. who owns tagging + alert enrichment?

devin: I'll wire the alert rules and playbook in PagerDuty. Ivy can own the eBPF PR and staging deploy. Sam, can you produce 1h sample telemetry for the canary?

sam: will attach sample in the incident doc. quick numbers included above.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: egress_gating v1 scheduled to staging at 1761303600 (ETA 14:00 UTC).

devin: final ask: add metric slice_gate_backpressure_seconds so we can quantify how long we hold slices under gate. Optimize team wants 48h of metrics before wider rollout.

ivy: will add tenant_gate_hits, rerouted_tokens_est, slice_gate_active, slice_gate_backpressure_seconds. starting canary 24h after staging deploy. :thumbsup:
